title: Major Skin 5-In-1 Blending Sponge
descriptionHtml:
✓ Pressed Powder Formula✓ Loose Powder Formula✓ Liquid Formula✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Cream Formula
What it is: A multi-use artistry sponge that precisely applies five products for a flawless finish: foundation, blush, contour, highlighter, and setting powder.

Brush Formulation: All Formulas

Brush Coverage: Buildable

Ingredient Callouts: It is vegan and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Patrick reimagined the beauty sponge for ultimate versatility. Hand-crafted and cut to perfection, it adapts to every angle of the face seamlessly. With a bouncy rounded base to blend complexion products, a flat edge for flawless sculpting, and a tapered point for detail, it's made to do the most.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Dampen artistry sponge before applying liquid or cream formulas.
-Rounded base: Apply liquid and cream foundation and blush formulas, bouncing product into skin and building to your desired level of coverage.
-Flat edge: Sculpt cheekbones, jawlines, and nose by pressing cream contour into skin with the flat edge. You can also press powder into targeted areas to set makeup without caking.
-Point: Apply products like highlighter and concealer to hard-to-reach areas with ultimate precision, such as the corner of the eyes.
